Consider the following C program:

The value printed by the given C program is ________ . (Answer in integer)
explanation:
Let us trace the function gate(14362) step-by-step:

1. Initialization:
• $n = 14362$
• $newnum = 0$, $turn = 0$, $t = 1$

2. First while loop: while (n >= t) t *= 10;
• $t$ becomes $100000$ because $100000 > 14362$.
• Then, t /= 10; makes $t = 10000$.

3. Second while loop execution: while (t > 0)

• Iteration 1 ($t = 10000$):
  - $d = 14362 / 10000 = 1$
  - $n = 14362 \% 10000 = 4362$
  - $t = 10000 / 10 = 1000$
  - $turn = 0$ (Condition if (turn) is FALSE)
  - $turn = (0 + 1) \% 2 = 1$

• Iteration 2 ($t = 1000$):
  - $d = 4362 / 1000 = 4$
  - $n = 4362 \% 1000 = 362$
  - $t = 1000 / 10 = 100$
  - $turn = 1$ (Condition if (turn) is TRUE):
    $newnum = 10 \times 0 + 4 = 4$
  - $turn = (1 + 1) \% 2 = 0$

• Iteration 3 ($t = 100$):
  - $d = 362 / 100 = 3$
  - $n = 362 \% 100 = 62$
  - $t = 100 / 10 = 10$
  - $turn = 0$ (Condition if (turn) is FALSE)
  - $turn = (0 + 1) \% 2 = 1$

• Iteration 4 ($t = 10$):
  - $d = 62 / 10 = 6$
  - $n = 62 \% 10 = 2$
  - $t = 10 / 10 = 1$
  - $turn = 1$ (Condition if (turn) is TRUE):
    $newnum = 10 \times 4 + 6 = 46$
  - $turn = (1 + 1) \% 2 = 0$

• Iteration 5 ($t = 1$):
  - $d = 2 / 1 = 2$
  - $n = 2 \% 1 = 0$
  - $t = 1 / 10 = 0$
  - $turn = 0$ (Condition if (turn) is FALSE)
  - $turn = (0 + 1) \% 2 = 1$

The loop terminates as $t = 0$.

The function returns $newnum = 46$.
